name: Manifest Trust → Collision Adapter
problem: Bridge authenticated manifests through strict position-bound transparency evidence into collision analysis without silently accepting downgraded or modified verifier backends.
hypothesis: An explicit read-only contract that pins v0.8 inclusion, v0.7 transition/witness semantics, v0.3 collision behavior, policy digests, and dependency source hashes will reduce verifier-substitution and proof-position ambiguity while preserving rollback and non-interference.
beneficiaries: optional sibling consumers that explicitly adopt the adapter contract

interfaces.name: build_backend_contract
assumptions: contract is pinned before untrusted policy mutation

interfaces.name: normalize_trusted_manifest
emitted_outputs: normalized manifest with provenance or rejection
assumptions: configured root/witness keys are authoritative externally

evaluation_vector.reproducibility: exact-package verification pending final ZIP freeze
evaluation_vector.transferability: blocked on real authenticated sibling manifest
evaluation_vector.latency_cost_burden: low-to-moderate; dependency files are SHA-256 checked per normalization
evaluation_vector.observability: high; contract, policy, evidence, subresult and backend digests
evaluation_vector.non_interference: high local evidence; read-only/fail-open sibling continuity

acceptance_tests: valid signed manifest passes v0.8 inclusion + v0.7 transition/witness + v0.3 collision
manifest leaf hash bound in provenance
runtime dependency hashes match build-time pins
failure_modes: External trust-root/witness-key governance may be wrong
Valid signatures do not prove semantic truth
Source-file integrity assumes file-backed Python modules
If adapter source and external package identity are both replaced before verification, internal pins alone are insufficient
Real sibling transfer not yet tested

compatibility.v0.3: rollback retained; v0.4 intentionally requires new strict inclusion evidence schema

revalidation_conditions: real signed sibling evidence becomes available
deployment no longer exposes file-backed Python sources
next_experiment: Run an authoritative signed sibling manifest unchanged through v0.4. If unavailable, publish a read-only sibling manifest conformance contract/fixture validator without assuming sibling authority.
